# Chimera — AGENTS.md

<!-- CHIMERA-LAW -->
> **RULE 0 — EVERY MEMBRANE IS A THEORY. STATE IT BEFORE YOU BUILD IT.** Three parts, all three
> required: a **STATEMENT** someone could disagree with · a **PREDICTION** you have not measured
> yet · a **FALSIFIER** named *before* the run. **A description survives any result; a theory can
> lose.** No falsifier, no build.
>
> **RULE 1 — DERIVE IT BEFORE YOU TRAIN IT.** A parameter sweep is an admission the derivation was
> not done. Before any run, any sweep, any "let's try N variants": trace the variables and show the
> equations close. If you are choosing a number, you broke the chain and substituted taste for a
> law. Ask what QUESTION each variant answers — if the answer is "which number is best", STOP.
>
> **RULE 0 IS ENFORCED AT S-1 VALIDATE** — every port tested alone, and `port_test()` REFUSES to
> register a test that names no falsifier. The model it feeds: `docs/THE_COMPILER.md` — ports →
> primitives → programs → parser → runtime → calibration.
>
> **[docs/THE_LAW.md](docs/THE_LAW.md)** · the method: `docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md` §0
> · 27 rules: `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` · gate: `python tools/training_gate.py`
<!-- CHIMERA-LAW -->

> **This file POINTS. It does not duplicate.** Rewritten 2026-07-16, from 408 lines.
> Amended 2026-08-03 (operator delegation): the retired task-board session shape removed —
> one contradiction, found the way this file predicted, fixed by pointing.
>
> It used to carry its own copy of The Contract, the Feature Ledger, the project
> structure, and the pipeline — all of which `CLAUDE.md` also carried. Three copies of a
> rule is not three times the safety; it is three things to update and two that will not
> be. Both previous attempts to fix that were patches, and the second one's commit
> message is the diagnosis: *"the amendment landed on some lines and not others — agents
> obeyed the stale ones."*
>
> Measured the day this was rewritten: **ten gates had shipped and this file mentioned
> ZERO of them.** Not from neglect — from architecture. A doc that duplicates a fact
> will drift from it, always, and no amount of diligence fixes that. A doc that POINTS
> at a fact cannot drift, because it does not hold one.
>
> So this file now holds **only what nothing else holds**, and points at the rest.

---

## READ THESE, IN THIS ORDER

**New agent? Paste `ChimeraEngine/ONBOARDING.md` into your session.** It is the single
onboarding: you are the PHYSICS (you own rendering + the workflow), the HUMAN side is the
operator + LM Studio's vision, and a proof is a dyadAnalysis (a number and a term, aligned).
You build THROUGH the engine.

**Any agent taking a construction task: read `docs/THE_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` (the
workflow — boundaries, the loop, the paste-back, the task envelope) and
`docs/THE_TRIANGLE_GUIDE.md` (the domain laws, each with the failure that taught
it).** Weaker agents operate by those two documents; tasks arrive in the manual's
envelope or they are not legal tasks.

Then the reading list `CLAUDE.md` owns — `docs/THE_LAW.md` → `docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md` →
`docs/THE_COMPILER.md` → `docs/THE_PIECES.md` — then `CLAUDE.md` itself
for Key Paths, hardware traps, and conventions. **The rule index is `docs/THE_LAW.md`'s
last section** — every rule, one line, with its enforcer and its canonical home.

> **Retired (2026-07-23): the Unreal Engine pipeline and its task-board session shape.**
> `SUCCESSOR_RUNBOOK.md`, `docs/FARMING_SEASONS.md`, `task_progress.md`, and the
> `core.preflight` / `core.task_board` / `core.postflight` / `core.circadian` loop that used
> to be prescribed here were removed from this file 2026-08-03. The modules still exist
> under `Chimera/core/`, and the GATES (research, witness, why, training) remain live
> machinery cited by `Chimera/docs/THE_FORMULA.md` — but the session is no longer entered
> through them. `WORKFLOW.md` (the foundry) no longer exists; `docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md` is the
> method.

## THE SESSION

The day is `docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md`'s loop: **ORIENT → NEXT → PROVE(X) → CHECK → COMMIT**.
The live state is printed by code that reads the actual store:

```bash
python tools/orient.py              # THE one live read: engine tree + verdict ledger + git
python tools/verdict.py status      # the Rule-0 biomechanics membranes, open + closed
```

Through the engine (MCP — `ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md`): `orient` first, every time;
`next` hands you the term — you do not pick it. The engine MCP is registered for opencode
in `opencode.json` (`chimera-engine`). The older story-lane read and timeline commands
were removed with the retired task-board session; `tools/orient.py` is the
replacement that reads the LIVE stores (engine_state.json + verdict_registry.json + git).

The renderer decision is **settled — the C++ Vulkan engine is the renderer**
(`docs/THE_RENDERER_DECISION.md` records the verdict): `ChimeraEngine/engine/engine.cpp`
renders the teddy (splat shell → `/membrane` + `/frame`) with a depth buffer for correct
front/back occlusion. **The dyad watches a MOVIE, not a still** — render a rotation
(`ChimeraEngine/cpp_bridge.py::render_teddy_movie`), encode it (`encode_movie` → MP4), and
judge it with `senses.watch()` running Ollama's qwen3.8 with `think:false` and `num_ctx`
sized to the frames (see `ChimeraEngine/senses.py`).

---

## WHAT ONLY THIS FILE HOLDS

### Research Agent (`chimera-research` mode)

Any mode can invoke on-demand web research without going through the Orchestrator. The
Research Agent's ONLY job is to research, search, gather documentation, and return
structured findings. It never writes code.

```python
new_task(mode="chimera-research", message="Research: <your question here>")
```
```
Agent(subagent_type: "mode-research", prompt: "Research: <your query here>")
```

It queries the DNA graph first (`g.query("pathway", ...)`, `g.query("feature", ...)`) and
stops if the answer already exists. Mode definition: `.roo/modes/research-agent.md`.

**Research is not optional** — it is an S4 enforcer (`Chimera/docs/THE_FORMULA.md`;
`Chimera/core/research_gate.py`). It covers TECHNICAL/INFRASTRUCTURE decisions, not just
game assets. **A "Build toward the seed" task cannot waive it at all** — that task's
premise is that the thing does NOT exist, so nothing in this repo can supply the answer,
which is exactly why the task exists.

### Subagent delegation

A subagent has full authority to try 5+ parameter combinations before reporting blocked,
and records every attempt so the next agent inherits the pathway instead of re-paying for
it. **`blocked` is a verdict that must be EARNED** — bare `blocked` is forbidden; give a
cause and evidence, or run `core/solver.py`. But note the boundary this file used to get
wrong: it said *"never ask for human help"* full stop. **The human is one of the two legal
terminals.** Taste bottoms out in them and nowhere else — it is EARNED
(`core/trainables/attunement.py: HUMAN_TEST_BAR`), never requested to dodge work. Refusing
to ask about a MEASURABLE thing is right; refusing to ask about FUN is just guessing.

**SPIACE implementation agents run under `ChimeraEngine/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md`** — the
session contract (green baseline, done-is-a-log, docs-last-append-only, handoff on
context exhaustion, scratch quarantine), key paths, and the staged-prompt pattern.
Paste it or point at it at the top of every SPIACE task prompt.

---

## THE THING TO ACTUALLY UNDERSTAND

**No reference, no verdict.** The system never decides what is good on its own. A human —
or an objective a human authored — supplies the reference; the machine attunes to it and
reports how close it got.

**A claim is not true because it is written down.** Every gate exists because prose said
one thing and the machine did another. `verified` meant nothing until the Witness Gate
demanded an evidence node; the node meant nothing until the **Why Gate** demanded its
chain reach **PHYSICS** or **THE HUMAN** — the only terminals, because they are the only
answers that need no observer. **An LLM is never a terminal**: its answer is another
claim, so the walk recurses past it (`python -m core.why --feature X --loop`).

**A file existing is not proof — you wrote the file.** A compile is not proof (H-14). A
verb needs behavior, not metadata (H-21).

# Chimera — Project Manual

<!-- CHIMERA-LAW -->
> **RULE 0 — EVERY MEMBRANE IS A THEORY. STATE IT BEFORE YOU BUILD IT.** Three parts, all three
> required: a **STATEMENT** someone could disagree with · a **PREDICTION** you have not measured
> yet · a **FALSIFIER** named *before* the run. **A description survives any result; a theory can
> lose.** No falsifier, no build.
>
> **RULE 1 — DERIVE IT BEFORE YOU TRAIN IT.** A parameter sweep is an admission the derivation was
> not done. Before any run, any sweep, any "let's try N variants": trace the variables and show the
> equations close. If you are choosing a number, you broke the chain and substituted taste for a
> law. Ask what QUESTION each variant answers — if the answer is "which number is best", STOP.
>
> **RULE 0 IS ENFORCED AT S-1 VALIDATE** — every port tested alone, and `port_test()` REFUSES to
> register a test that names no falsifier. The model it feeds: `docs/THE_COMPILER.md` — ports →
> primitives → programs → parser → runtime → calibration.
>
> **[docs/THE_LAW.md](docs/THE_LAW.md)** · the method: `docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md` §0
> · 27 rules: `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` · gate: `python tools/training_gate.py`
<!-- CHIMERA-LAW -->

> **GRAVITY AMENDMENT (2026-08-25, operator decree): the world constant is Earth-standard
> `g = 9.80665 m/s²`.** The derived-world chain that produced `g = 7.076` (`aBlueWorld` mass →
> Froude) is RETIRED HISTORY — its stories stay because they earned their rules, but no live
> constant comes from them. The one source of truth is the published ledger
> `story/theHuman/numbers.json`, read dynamically by `tools/world.py::gravity()`; nothing
> hardcodes either number. Wherever older prose says "this world is 0.722 Earth", read it as
> a record of the retired regime.

> # HIERARCHY × PHYSICS × HUMAN = a complete 4-dimensional video game experience
>
> **A product, not a sum** — any factor at zero takes the whole result to zero, and the other two
> cannot make up for it. Hierarchy alone is an outline; physics alone has no scale to live at;
> both without the human are correct and meaningless. Every failure here has been one factor going
> to zero (39 variables traced and rendered from noise = physics 0; a walker built six membranes
> deep with nothing proven beneath it = hierarchy 0).
>
> # HOW THIS GAME IS BUILT (2026-07-28 — the method; the machinery now lives in the Chimera Engine)
>
> **You write CHAPTERS. Each chapter must be PROVEN, VISUAL, and LEARNED.**
> There is no asset pipeline and no content budget. The world is one story told in order
> from a seed, where every sentence is also an equation, and the equation also draws itself.
>
> **A chapter is a membrane.** The story's term tree lives in `ChimeraEngine/engine_state.json`
> (declared in `Chimera/docs/THE_STORY.md`); each term's law is what proves it (a PHYSICS
> measurement pointer or THE HUMAN), and its appearance is `render()` — the equation draws
> itself. The engine (`ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md`) is the machinery: the same gates at every
> term, so adding world means adding a term, never more code. (`story/` survives as empty
> scaffolding from the retired chapter-folder lane.)
>
> * **PROVEN** — the law derives this membrane's numbers from its parent's, and *predicts a
>   fact it was never fitted to*. If you are choosing a number, you broke the chain and
>   substituted taste for a law. (¶4 put in η, mₑ, 13.6 eV → **3760 K** for recombination;
>   literature ~3700 K.)
> * **VISUAL** — `emit()` sits in the *same file* as `derive()` and reads the *same numbers*,
>   so appearance cannot drift from physics. **No aesthetic passes** — a colour is a
>   measurement. Watch it turn in the live viewer, and **sample the video**: one frame cannot
>   show motion, and comparing frames is what catches a scene that silently didn't switch.
> * **LEARNED** — the law fixes the FORM; the free numbers are *trained* against that
>   membrane's own measurable target, never tuned. Program the rules, train the numbers.
>
> **Every membrane works in its own local units** (a boundary supplies its own unit, grain
> size included) — which is why 41 orders of magnitude cost no precision.
> **Linear yet branched**: every path from the seed is one line; chapters can be revisited
> and improved without disturbing neighbours, because a child consumes its parent's
> `numbers.json`, never its parent's reasoning.
> **From zero only ADDITION is legal** — nothing is subtracted from the story.
> **Nothing simulates outside the Chimera Engine.** (MuJoCo and its trainers were deleted
> 2026-07-28; a foreign engine's floor is not the planet.)

> The world's matter is **typed bricks** trained against reality's own numbers, never
> hand-tuned. Object genomes recovered from real scans (`Construction/`) and genomes
> generated from a learned latent (`WorldModel/`) are the same library from two directions.
> The Unreal Engine 5 pipeline is retired (2026-07-23); everything below is engine-agnostic.

## NEW AGENT? START HERE — READ THESE FIVE, IN THIS ORDER

**The order is not a suggestion.** Each one is unreadable without the one before it: you cannot
judge a method without the law it serves, cannot place a measurement without the specification it
belongs to, and cannot trust the ledger without knowing what "validated" was made to mean.

| # | document | what it gives you |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | **[`docs/THE_WOLFRAM_FRAME.md`](docs/THE_WOLFRAM_FRAME.md)** | **THE OPERATOR'S ARCHITECTURE, AS GIVEN (2026-08-25)** — the Wolfram lineage, membranes as railroad switches into the fourth dimension, tissue as separate triangle systems, determinism = ROM extremes + CA-filled interior, the trained in-between, Earth gravity, open-source doctrine. **Where this conflicts with older prose, it wins.** |
| 1 | **[`docs/THE_LAW.md`](docs/THE_LAW.md)** | **RULE 0** — statement · prediction · falsifier, before any build. **RULE 1** — derive it before you train it. |
| 2 | **[`docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md`](docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md)** | the method as one sequence, **now beginning at S-1 VALIDATE** — every port tested alone before anything is framed. |
| 3 | **[`docs/THE_COMPILER.md`](docs/THE_COMPILER.md)** | **the operating model.** ports → primitives → programs → parser → runtime → calibration, and `dx/dt = f(x,u,p,w)` where `f` is PROGRAMMED and `p` is never chosen. Includes **passive tissue is universal** — the same ports for grass, rock, tree, wall, hull. |
| 4 | **[`docs/THE_PIECES.md`](docs/THE_PIECES.md)** | **the ledger.** 174 pieces with provenance and status; §16 is the port ledger — what is validated, what is unmeasured, what is merely specified. |
| 5 | **[`ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md`](ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md)** | the engine: the PROVE workflow as an MCP tool surface — `orient`/`next`/`frame`/`question`/`classify`/`render`/`prove`/`decide`. |
| 6 | **[`docs/THE_FIELD_ASSEMBLY.md`](docs/THE_FIELD_ASSEMBLY.md)** | **the theory of the assembly lane** (2026-08-10): one density field, one force law, N readers; membranes as packets that snap together (Lego in every direction). The STATEMENT/PREDICTION/FALSIFIER, the vocabulary, what is already built, and the unbuilt lane B1–B4 with falsifiers named BEFORE each build. Rebuild context from here. |

> The retired `story/` lane (chapters/proven/visual/learned) was removed with the task-board
> session; its folder tree survives as empty scaffolding. The live hierarchy is
> `ChimeraEngine/engine_state.json` (the story, proven through the engine), and the live
> session read is `python tools/orient.py` (engine + verdict ledger + git).

**WHERE IT STANDS (2026-08-25, re-measured after the doctrine session): 18/21 ports validated
under Earth-standard gravity (the 3 non-passing are missing-data refusals, not physics failures:
`terrain_footprint` + `granular_repose` await an un-grown `story/theGround` membrane,
`rock_fracture` awaits the materials library) · hard joint stops landed in `world.py::load_body`
(JOINT_LIMIT overshoot 3.555° → ~0.05°) · primitives 4/7 with END_STOP being re-derived to the
Mother-Nature division of labor (ligaments arrest the approach, geometry owns the boundary) and
UPRIGHT/RHYTHM_DRIVE in diagnosis · actions 7/11 · theDeterminism FRAMED at S0 — "in-between
motion emerges from CA interaction under published gravity, never from interpolation" — next gate
S2a PROVENANCE · canon: `docs/THE_WOLFRAM_FRAME.md` (publishedology, allometry, Earth gravity,
open-source doctrine) outranks older prose where they conflict.** One port per object is a
beginning, not a passive-tissue model. The ledger is the ledger; do not cite the specification as
proof.

```bash
python tools/port_tests.py && python tools/primitive_tests.py && python tools/action_tests.py
```

---

**-1. `ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md` — HOW THE GAME IS BUILT.** The term hierarchy, proven/
   visual/learned, the two authors (human = THE HUMAN terminal, physics = measurement
   pointers). Everything below is the machinery that serves it.

0. **`docs/THE_FOLDING.md` — WHAT A LAW MAY CONNECT TO** (2026-07-31, the operator's idea:
   *serials for the solutions, protein folding as the metaphor*). Every published number declares
   its unit (86%); every law declares what it consumes and produces. **FOLD** = the dimensional
   shape, so laws that share one substitute for each other. **BOND** = the exact unit *including
   offset*, so K and degC share a fold and may never connect. **REGIME** = the range the law holds
   over. Every serious defect found on 2026-07-31 was a MISFOLD — the right quantity docking at the
   wrong interface, silently — and `the retired folding audit` (retired with the story lane) found
   one nobody knew about, in code committed that day as PROVEN. **The folding principle still
   holds: a unit declares what it may connect to — watch for dead-term defects (`* 0.0`,
   `** 0.0`) that leave a plausible-looking constant.**

0b. **`python -m core.terms <word>`** — the TERMINOLOGY INDEX (73 terms, `docs/TERMINOLOGY.md`).
   This project uses genetics, physics and cell-biology terms **literally, not as metaphor**:
   read "recombination" or "membrane" or "heritability" as a figure of speech and you will
   write the wrong code. Look a word up before assuming it means what it means elsewhere.
   `--list` for all of them, `--search X` to find related ones.
1. **`docs/THE_WORKFLOW.md`** — THE METHOD, as ONE sequence (consolidated 2026-08-02 from every
   workflow document in the repo). `ORIENT → NEXT → PROVE(X) → CHECK → COMMIT`, where `PROVE` is
   **S0 FRAME · S1 QUESTION · S2 SATURATE · S3 CLASSIFY · S4 DERIVE · S5 TRAIN · S6 EMIT ·
   S7 DYAD · S8 RECOMPOSE**. **S4 is new and it is why:** the old formula read
   `MEASURE(TRAIN(PROGRAM(V)))` with no DERIVE in it, and a four-variant parameter sweep went
   straight through that hole. Read this first; it points to every other doc that matters.
   **ENFORCED as tooling** — the Chimera Engine MCP server (`ChimeraEngine/MCP_ENGINE.md`; agent
   onboarding `ChimeraEngine/ONBOARDING.md`): `prove` runs the gates and refuses until they pass.
1b. **`docs/THE_PIECES.md`** — the INVENTORY the consolidation was built from: **174 pieces**, each
   with its source and its status, and **§14 names the nine that are written down, load-bearing,
   and done by nothing** (S1/S2 saturation, S8's gate, the why-chain and the coin for membranes,
   the night phase, the six directions, the demographic, live surprise capture, `work_queue()`).
   Read it when you think something is missing — it is the proof the consolidation lost nothing,
   and it is the honest backlog of the method. Superseded docs are in `docs/archive/`.
2. `docs/THE_PIPELINE.md` — where a genome comes from and what it becomes (the splat spine, stage
   by stage, with its own honest gaps). Then `Construction/SPLAT_DNA_WORKFLOW.md` — scan → object
   genome, status marked `PROVEN` / `DESIGNED` / `FRONTIER` per stage, file inventory in §7.5.
3. `WorldModel/ML_PIPELINE.md` — the generative half. SplatVAE, three training paths,
   hierarchical LOD, infinite world, cellular rules, physics universe.
4. `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` — **27 rules** for diagnosing a live system without
   fooling yourself. Read before debugging *or reporting* anything. Rules 12-17 (2026-08-01) are the
   control set: run a KNOWN subject through the whole instrument, measure at the scale the thing
   lives at, never threshold on a quantile of what you are measuring, suspect the data's own
   construction, match formulas not names, and derive the shape while physics sets the level.
5. **The GPU is mandatory** for rendering, segmentation, DNA recovery and training.

## How work gets done

- **TRAIN it, don't hand-tune it** (2026-07-14; full spec: `docs/TRAINING_PROTOCOL.md`). If a feature is **DATA** (prices, damage, yields, morphology, layouts, spawn tables), do NOT tune it by reasoning — an LLM manages ~20 edits/hour and `core/trainer.py` does ~30,000 evals/sec. Write a **domain** (`core/trainables/<f>.py` — `seed`/`mutate`/`measure`, reporting FACTS only), write an **objective** (`docs/objectives/<f>.json` — what GOOD means, in physics not taste, **with at least one `maximize` term or you get a satisficer**), then train it **inside a membrane** and read the **PINNED** walls. A degenerate winner is not a failure — it is the optimiser auditing your spec at 35kHz and finding the hole you would have defended in review. **Iterate the objective, never the artifact.** If a feature is **CODE** (needs a UBT build to evaluate: ~6 min/eval), it is NOT trainable — author it, one at a time.
- **A MEASUREMENT WITHOUT A CONTROL IS NOT A MEASUREMENT** (2026-08-01; full account with the numbers: `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` rules 12–17, six rules earned in one day, each reversing a written conclusion). Push a KNOWN subject — a thing you made — through the WHOLE instrument: the clay control returned the splat-fitter's own signature to 6.9%. The corollaries are their own rules: measure at the scale the thing lives at (0.6 px octaves read as detail LOST) · never threshold on a quantile of the population you measure (clay and take grew to 5,619 splats, identical to the digit) · suspect the instrument's construction (the cross-hatch was the canvas's, 27.8×; the new code was 1.1×, innocent) · matching names is not matching definitions (`aniso`, four misfolds in one afternoon) · derive the shape, let physics set the level, and publish the disagreement (the 20× gap IS the threshold-hillslope finding).
- **BACKTRACE — DEBUG UP THE CHAIN, NOT FORWARD FROM THE SYMPTOM** (2026-08-01, the operator's method; full account: `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` rules 18–21). Forward debugging finds where an error became VISIBLE; backtracing finds where it ENTERED — the foot through the floor was faithfully executing `aBlueWorld`'s `g = 7.076`, four membranes up, after six hypotheses verified clean at the foot. Corollaries, each earned the same day: *one quantity, one landmark* (`trochanterionheight` ingested as "hip height" put three leg lengths in one leg, 3.11 cm apart, dimensionally invisible to fold/bond/regime) · *the instrument must move with the membrane and keep no copy of it* (four stale-copy convictions in one day; read PUBLISHED numbers, refuse when absent — a fallback is an assumption wearing a hat — and never import the membrane you judge) · *in a grown world an authored phenotype is the defect* (the walker read 246 Earth adults while everything around it was derived — an Earth phenotype, not a bug) · *the witness is the fitness function, and the measured dataset becomes the CONTROL, not the answer* (reproduce the dataset at 9.80665 unfitted, THEN set the world's gravity).
- **THE SERIAL IS THE PLACE IN TIME, AND THE REMAKE HAS A PROCEDURE** (2026-08-01, the operator's; full account: `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` rules 22–24 + THE REMAKE PROCEDURE). Containment and chronology part company the instant the tree branches; `the timeline stamper (retired with the story lane)` stamps the derived epoch into every `numbers.json` AND every `story.md` (its first run caught `theHumanClock` 3 s after the seed and two colliding chapter-number pairs). Remake: gate first → **timeline order** → one membrane at a time, rename + consumers in one commit → **grow → chain_witness → folding audit → gate, in that order** → suspect the *column* once before the membrane. Two rules earned doing it: *check the generator before you believe the witness* (`grow.py` dying while `chain_witness` reported 42/0/0 off the last good file) · *an instrument needs an instrument* (the gate made four of its own bugs in a day — each a check applied outside the shape it was written for; there is no exemption for tools).
- **EVALUATE IT HONESTLY, or you are training LUCK** (2026-07-14; the hardest lesson this studio has learned). **One rollout from one initial condition is not a measurement — it is a coin toss.** Proven: the celebrated 13.52-body-length walker had `periodicity 0.25` (no repeating cycle at all) and lost 5.5 body lengths to a **one-micron** nudge of its start height. That is Lyapunov divergence: no attractor → no limit cycle → **no gait**. The GA had spent 80,000 evaluations selecting lucky dice, and under honest physics that champion scores **worse than an untrained brain**. THE RULE: score every genome from **N randomized starts and keep the WORST** (report `robustness` = worst/mean; a real limit cycle is ~1.0, a fraud is ~0). It costs Nx compute — **that is what the GPU is for**. And check the physics you inherited: `TORQUE=22 N·m` on a 0.622 kg creature is **35 N·m/kg** (a human hip is 3) and flung the body **3.4 km** into the air; pybullet's constraint servo merely *contained* that violence instead of NaN-ing, which is *why* there was never a limit cycle to find. **A body permanently in flight has no contact to build a gait out of.**
- **A PARAMETER SWEEP IS AN ADMISSION THE DERIVATION WAS NOT DONE** (2026-08-02, the operator's correction for the SECOND time; full account: `docs/THE_LAW.md` RULE 1 and `Chimera/docs/EXPERIMENTAL_METHOD.md` rule 1; enforced: `python tools/training_gate.py --target-speed X --stride-s Y`). Four variants asking the body for a speed it cannot walk at rank four failures: this world is `g = 7.076` and `theHuman` derives its own `0.9924 m/s`; the trainer targeted 1.285 m/s measured on Earth — Fr 0.183 there, **Fr 0.254 here** — and the crouch was the only stable point in a contradictory reward. **THE TELL:** if a variant answers *"which number is best"*, STOP — that is a search where a derivation belongs. Sweeping is legitimate only for genuinely FREE numbers, and a Froude-derived target is not free.
- **DERIVE IT BEFORE YOU TRAIN IT** (2026-07-28; full derivation: `docs/THE_MATHEMATICS_OF_WALKING.md`). The operator's correction, verbatim: *"You have to know it works because it's proven mathematically first before you start training."* Every membrane — hip, foot, hand — has a mathematical principle; **trace ALL the variables and show the equations CLOSE**, or training is guess-and-check on a two-hour feedback loop (which is exactly what four failed walk runs were). This is `PROGRAM the rules / TRAIN the numbers` enforced: I had been trying to **train the rules**. PROVEN VALUE: measuring myobody's own constants (M 82.04 kg, CoM H 0.965 m, leg L 0.845 m, I_hip 2.879 kg·m²) *derives* the gait instead of guessing it — cadence from the swing pendulum `T = 2π√(I/mgd) = 1.506 s`, placement from `ω₀ = √(g/H) = 3.188 rad/s`, speed from the **Froude number `Fr = v²/(gL)`** (same Fr = dynamically similar gait at ANY gravity — one law covers Earth/Mars/Moon). **The check that it is a real derivation and not a story: it predicted a fact it was never fitted to** — on the Moon the walk→run transition falls to 0.83 m/s, which is *why Apollo astronauts bunny-hopped.* A reward you tuned predicts nothing; a law predicts the worlds you have not trained.
- **A RENDER MAY NOT INVENT A BODY, AND A SIBLING'S NUMBER COMES THROUGH THE PARENT** (2026-07-29, both caught by the operator looking at one picture). Two failures of the same species — *an assertion wearing a derivation's clothes*. (1) The planet membranes drew a sphere beside the world commented "the star, drawn as a marker, distance declared-false". At any framing showing the planet a star is **off-screen and sub-pixel** (28,000 radii, 0.25°); drawn at 1.3 radii it is **a moon**, and no moon was ever derived. A declared exaggeration may *scale what exists* — it may never *mint an object*. **A light source is told by its light**: the terminator, the lit limb and the shadow had already said where the star was. (2) `thePlanets` needed the star's colour, could not reach its SIBLING `theStar`, and **typed `"T_star_surface": 5772.0` under a comment claiming it was carried from the system** — so changing the star's mass moved the snow line and left the sunlight the same colour forever. The parent must carry it; being what both children can see is what a parent is FOR. **THE TEST IS A SLIDER: move a free number at the top and every consequence must move; whatever does not move is typed.** Now `M_system` walks the star K→G→F→A (aOrangeStar → aYellowStar → aYellowWhiteStar → aWhiteStar), shifts the snow line 1.54→7.56 AU, and selects a *different* habitable world with different gravity and climate. **This is why the hierarchy is followed in order: you build the star first so that you can see the planet.**
- **ONE CHANGE AT A TIME — three coupled changes is a THREE-BODY PROBLEM** (2026-07-28, the operator's frame). Three simultaneous interventions have no attributable solution: if it works you cannot say why, and if it fails you know even less. Run **A/B with ONE variable**, ideally *simultaneously* on the same GPU (memory allows ~2×4096 worlds) so wall-clock and conditions are identical. **AND WATCH FOR THE SECOND VARIABLE YOU CHANGED BY ACCIDENT:** swapping the action space silently changed the *exploration scale* too — the same nominal `log_std` gave a **6× smaller** muscle-space perturbation through the synergy decoder, and survival fell 69%→0.5% for that reason alone, not the one under test. Measure the effective perturbation and match it.
- **COMMAND THE PROCESS AND ITS STOP CONDITION, NEVER THE FINAL POSITION** (2026-07-28, the operator's law; `docs/CONTROLLER_MAP.md`). The hand does not aim its fingers at coordinates — it *closes until it cannot*, and the **object** decides where they land. So one GRAB serves a pin and a bowling ball: the object parameterises the *result*, not the command. **Positions are OUTPUTS.** This is why muscles+reflexes are the right substrate (a muscle contracts until force balances load; stop conditions are sensory = reflexes) and every atom is `apply effort → stop when a sensor says stop` = a state-machine transition. **In rewards: never reward matching a target pose** — reward the OUTCOME (grasped / balanced / still). MEASURED: the full body's flailing arms were fixed *not* by a pose target but by rewarding "be still" + costing wasted drive; stillness climbed 0.85→0.93 in lockstep with survival and the arms' resting position **emerged**.
- **THE GATE JUDGES LEARNING, NOT HEAT** (2026-07-28; the learning gate). Temperature was the operator's original un-fakeable proof of GPU work and it was right — until a genuinely-working run (myoLegs learning to stand, survival 0→92%) peaked at **53 °C** and was REFUSED by the 54 °C floor. Temperature is a **proxy**, and a heavy low-occupancy workload does real work while running cool. **The LEARNING CURVE is the direct proof**: you cannot drive a metric 0→92% without genuinely simulating millions of steps. So the gate passes on demonstrated learning and reports **time and temperature as READOUTS** ("how long will this take" is the number you plan around). It got STRICTER: a coasting run has *neither* heat *nor* a curve, and is still refused.
- **VERIFY YOUR OWN MEASUREMENT, NOT JUST THE CLAIM** (2026-07-28). `verify-the-finding` extended to the instrument. TWO near-misses in one session: (1) mining muscle synergies from **sampled** actions reported "164 dims for 90% of movement" and would have refuted the literature — but independent Gaussian exploration noise is **full-rank by construction**; mining the policy's *mean* gives **8 dims for 90%**, a 20× difference that was entirely my noise. (2) A 4-seed test of the full-body stand averaged 0.60 m and nearly had me tell the operator the milestone was hollow; 12 seeds show **10/12 stand tall**. Before reporting a result that contradicts a prior one, suspect the instrument first.
- **READ THE HIERARCHY AS A STORY — a plot hole IS a missing why-edge** (2026-07-28; `python ChimeraEngine/story.py read|audit|path`). A chronicle says "this, then this"; a STORY says each thing **causes** the next, which is exactly the why-graph. So narrative coherence and derivational validity are the *same property*, and the hierarchy can be audited **by reading it**: an unearned conclusion (proven parent, all children open), a silent assertion (settled with no claim written), a Chekhov's gun (introduced, never fired), an orphan. PROVEN: the audit independently rediscovered `aPlanet` declared-but-unproven, and found that **`theStory` — the seed of the entire hierarchy — carries no claim at all.** A term's SERIAL (its path from the seed) IS its compressed story; `story.py path X` prints it as one sentence.

## Hardware and its traps (measured 2026-07-23)

- **RTX 4090, 24.5 GB VRAM · 128 GB RAM.**
- `C:` PCIe NVMe (OS + pagefile) · `D:` SATA SSD · `E:` spanned QLC NVMe pair · `F:` USB SSD.
- **RANDOM read is the only disk number that matters for a big model** — MoE reads are
  scattered, so sequential benchmarks mislead. Re-measured 2026-07-29 with the OS cache
  bypassed (`FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING`), 400 reads over a 37 GB file, and the old
  "`E:` 352 MB/s" note was **wrong — E: does 1,198 MB/s at 4 MB**:

  | drive | hardware | 1 MB | 4 MB | 16 MB |
  |---|---|---:|---:|---:|
  | **C:** | PCIe NVMe 1.86 TB | 1,567 | **2,787** | 3,055 |
  | `E:` | 2× Intel SSDPEKNW010T8 (660p QLC), spanned | 692 | 1,198 | 1,331 |
  | `F:` | Samsung T7 (USB) | 576 | 812 | 933 |
  | `D:` | Samsung 860 EVO (SATA) | 464 | 509 | 524 |

  **C: is 2.3× E: and is the only drive worth streaming a model from** — which collides
  with the pagefile rule below, so weigh it per job rather than assuming E: is faster
  because it is the "fast" drive.
- **RAM is MAXED and cannot be raised**: MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK, 4/4 slots filled with
  32 GB DDR5-5400 (~86 GB/s dual-channel), board ceiling 128 GB. Anything needing more
  than ~150 GB resident is a **platform change** (Threadripper/EPYC, 8–12 channels), not
  an upgrade. See `docs/LOCAL_BIG_MODELS.md` for what that rules in and out.
- **Never memory-map a model on `C:`** — it competes with `pagefile.sys`, and SSDs degrade
  past ~80% full. Measured 50% slower in place than the benchmark predicted.
- **System Restore was entitled to 15% of `C:` (279 GB)** and silently consumed ~190 GB
  during large transfers, failing two of them. Cap it (admin):
  `vssadmin resize shadowstorage /for=C: /on=C: /maxsize=25GB`

## Conventions

- **Git: commit directly to `master`, never feature branches.** State branch + SHA on every
  push. Keep the tree clean, push without asking; surface only destructive actions.
- **Large artifacts stay gitignored** — model weights, the corpus, `web/*.npz`.
- **Never bind a server to `0.0.0.0`** — `127.0.0.1` reaches the agent and the browser and
  nobody else. Enforced by `.githooks/pre-commit` (`core/bind_guard.py`); genuine exposure
  needs a `# bind-public: <reason>` marker. Plain-language account: `docs/LOCAL_SERVERS.md`.
- **Every commit states who wrote it** — `Co-Authored-By:` or `Agent:`. Enforced by
  `.githooks/commit-msg`. Without it the history cannot answer "which AI made this change",

## MEMBRANE PROGRAMMING AND UNIVERSAL SIMULATION ARCHITECTURE (2026-07-21)

### The New Programming: Training Patterns & Scene Hierarchy Configuration
Setting up the training patterns is the new computer programming. In traditional programming, you write explicit `if/else` statements and loops to tell a computer exactly what to do. In membrane programming, we don't write traditional code—we define the **training patterns**, the **energy principles**, and the **mathematical constraints** that govern how energy and matter flow through the system.

### Multi-Genre Verification Gates (Spectroscopy & USGS/JPL Spectral Libraries)
The pipeline runs two parallel extraction paths:
- **The Visual Path:** Extracts geometric and topological patterns (hexagonal tessellation, sinuous curvature, fractal branching).
- **The Spectral Path:** Extracts reflectance curves and absorption features from USGS/JPL spectral libraries (silicate absorption bands at 1.4µm, 1.9µm, 2.2µm; vegetation "Red Edge" at 700-1300nm; iron oxide red/orange reflection 600-700nm).

When a potential membrane label is identified, it must be **cross-referenced and verified** by both the visual path and the spectral path. If the visual and spectral data align, the membrane is **verified by PHYSICS**, not just human visual interpretation.

### Physics-Based Modular Control Systems ("LEGO Puzzle" Connection Shapes)
The "connection shapes" are physics interfaces—the specific ways energy and matter flow between modules:
- **Gravitational Anchor:** Newtonian gravity, mass attraction — *All modules* snap to the planet's gravity field.
- **Spectral/Energy Port:** Light interception, "Red Edge" spectral signature, PAR distribution — *Biological modules* connect to the Sky/Sun energy source.
- **Hydrodynamic/Hydration Port:** Buoyancy, fluid drag, water hydration absorption bands (1.4µm, 1.9µm) — *Watercraft modules* connect to River/Ocean surfaces; *Root systems* connect to soil moisture.
- **Aerodynamic/Atmospheric Port:** Lift, drag, thrust, airflow patterns (Bernoulli's principle) — *Aircraft modules* connect to the atmosphere/sky layer.
- **Substrate/Geological Port:** Mineral absorption, soil topography, friction coefficients — *Building foundations, Tree roots, Character controllers* connect to the Ground/Surface layer.

### Verb Over Nouns Philosophy
The core of the system is the **verb**, not the noun/item:
- **THRUST:** applying energy to create motion (keyboard/input → thrust vector ports)
- **BALANCE:** adjusting Center of Gravity vs. Center of Thrust to stabilize torque
- **GROW:** following the flow of energy and matter from seed to canopy (phyllotaxis, fractal branching)
- **CONNECT:** snapping physics modules together via compatible connection shapes
- **SCAN:** using hyperspectral sensors to analyze chemical composition (spectral signatures)
- **NAVIGATE_ORBIT:** calculating and adjusting thrust to achieve stable orbit (Keplerian mechanics)
- **GROW_ECOSYSTEM:** planting seeds and watching biological networks grow based on environmental conditions

### Exploration Product / Universal Simulation Architecture
An educational exploration product — a universe simulator built on physics, not pre-scripted game mechanics. Players explore the universe from home by EXPERIENCING the flow of energy and matter through verbs.

**Hierarchy:**
- **Level 1 (Energy Source/Sky):** Solar granulation + Night sky stellar distribution → outputs photons and spectral environment.
- **Level 2 (Matter Source/Ground):** Basalt, Quartz, Sand dunes, Mud cracks → outputs soil minerals, topography, and water availability.
- **Level 3 (Transformation Engine/Biological Growth):** The seed-to-tree procedural growth → takes energy and matter from Levels 1 & 2, applies the training patterns, and outputs a procedurally grown tree structure with canopy.
- **Level 4 (Observer/Camera View):** Director's camera perspective → places the camera by the tree to view the Earth's ground, sky, and moon cohesively.

source.operator_material_direction.29fac.name: Operator direction: compact cell state and material inventory

document.text: Summary of operator direction: merge the graph and native surface work to master; list game materials before collecting properties. Explore a common distance-dependent interaction representation with triangular faces and variable-sized tetrahedral cells. Represent interiors by compact calculated variables, with interactions computing the response. Temperature, pressure and phase must be considered. The operator hypothesizes that surface tension, shear and fracture share molecular interactions; this hypothesis is preserved as a proposal, not treated as a demonstrated universal scalar material law.

source.material_reference.coolprop.name: CoolProp fluid correlations

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.coolprop.notes: Liquid-vapor surface tension correlations; current local adapter accepts 298.15 K only. Local Water/Ethanol artifacts and MIT license are already pinned.

source.material_reference.nist_fluids.name: NIST fluid properties

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.nist_fluids.notes: Density, thermodynamic and transport properties; surface tension on the saturation curve. Check each data product and range before intake.

source.material_reference.peridynamics.name: Peridynamic material models

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.peridynamics.notes: Bond-based versus neighborhood-dependent models; distance-only central-force models have restricted elastic response. Reference for architecture, not a material parameter table.

source.material_reference.cohesive.name: Cohesive interface response

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.cohesive.notes: Local traction versus separation; history-dependent damage; consistent coupling to bulk mechanics. Model reference, not selected material values.

source.material_reference.phase.name: Phase transitions and latent heat

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.phase.notes: Heat can change phase without increasing temperature during equilibrium coexistence; phase depends on thermodynamic conditions.

source.material_reference.wood.name: USDA Wood Handbook, mechanical properties

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.wood.notes: Species, grain direction and moisture dependent wood properties. Source selection must preserve those conditions.

source.material_reference.opensim.name: OpenSim muscle and tendon models

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.opensim.notes: Active muscle force-length-velocity and passive tendon curves; imported model defaults are not measured creature material constants.

source.material_reference.jarvis.name: NIST JARVIS datasets

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.jarvis.notes: Candidate crystalline elastic data; atomistic computed values do not automatically equal a manufactured alloy, porous rock or biological composite.

source.material_reference.foam.name: NIST wet foam mechanics

source.role: reference and acquisition route; no new numerical dataset admitted

source.material_reference.foam.notes: Constrained networks of liquid films and bubbles can resist shear; topology and volume fraction matter in addition to interfacial tension.

concept.reduced_cell_state.name: Compact interior state with face-based interaction

project_spec.authorization: operator direction in this conversation
project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Each variable-resolution cell retains sufficient internal state to compute its boundary response without resolving every molecule.
physical.prediction: Identical histories and inputs give equivalent impulses, heat and failure within declared resolution and frequency bounds.

contract.representation: Tetrahedral cells have four vertices and four triangular faces. Geometry is not a claim of molecular resolution.

persistent_state.geometry: rest/current volume, rest metric and orientation as needed
persistent_state.mass_kg: conserved inventory; may change through declared exchange
persistent_state.momentum_kg_m_s: dynamic state; velocity derived from mass when nonzero
persistent_state.energy_J: accounted mechanical and thermodynamic state under one convention
persistent_state.temperature_K: derived from EOS/energy where applicable, not a contradictory second independent energy
persistent_state.phase: phase fraction/order parameter where coexistence matters
persistent_state.history: deformation, plastic strain, damage, activation or reduced internal modes required by the selected law

contract.mechanical_interface: f_face = stress_tensor * outward_normal * area; shared internal face exchanges must be paired under one update owner.
contract.scheduling: Impact/contact/topology changes trigger work. Motion, sustained contact, diffusion, pressure transfer, delayed signals and thermal evolution continue on physical time or a qualified lazy advance. No blanket only-update-on-impact rule.
contract.reduction: Only eliminate interior degrees of freedom when their boundary response is retained by a constitutive or reduced model. Dynamics may require internal modes/history and nonlocal response.
contract.resolution: Refinement/coarsening conserves inventories and transfers history. Re-derive effective response and fracture energy at the cell size; preserve the declared fidelity envelope.
falsifier_controls: same elapsed time with different event batching
wave transit and irreversible crack history
contract.current_gap: Native variable-resolution cell response and event scheduling are not implemented by this documentation.

directional_response.material_axes: Grain/fiber/crystal orientation in a defined local frame, updated consistently with deformation.
directional_response.model: A symmetric stiffness matrix can describe a simple local quadratic response; full continuum anisotropy may require a fourth-order tensor or nonlinear material law.
directional_response.parameters: Directional stiffness, coupling, relaxation and failure are separately sourced.
directional_response.control: Rotate material axes relative to a fixed load and recover the expected directional response.

falsifier.statement: A hollow and a filled object respond identically because interior state was discarded; or an inactive cell loses accumulated time, energy or pressure.

model.hypothesis.molecular_tension_unifi.name: Proposed common molecular-interaction basis for matter

physical.statement: Distance-dependent interactions and a connected cell network may provide common computational machinery for multiple phases and fracture.
physical.narrow_scalar_case: A uniform constant gamma*A on exposed faces cannot encode every solid deformation. A constant-area shear produces no change in that energy.
physical.network_case: Internal constraints and topology can create emergent shear response, as in foams. This is a richer model than selecting one gamma value.
physical.force_form: For conservative interactions, force_i = -gradient_i U; dissipation and irreversible history require additional update laws.
physical.distance: Very short separations generally require repulsion; attraction and preferred separation cannot be represented as always-stronger pull at shorter distance.
physical.fracture: Stress waves can trigger and accompany damage. Fracture additionally changes connectivity/history and consumes or redistributes accounted energy.
physical.qualification: Proposed architecture; no universal potential, all-material phase derivation, or microscopic simulation has been demonstrated.

falsifier.statement: One fitted interaction matches indentation but misses shear, pressure response, phase conditions or fracture energy under independent inputs.

req.fundamental_force_scope.name: Four-force origins with scale-appropriate runtime models

project_spec.authorization: operator direction in this conversation
project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Choose effective state and response laws from the physical processes a player can observe; retain links to their fundamental origins and source data.
physical.prediction: The same exchange interface supports distinct qualified material laws without atom-scale cost or double-counted forces.

contract.role: Physical-origin and approximation map. Four force categories do not alone specify a material, its state or a calculable game model.
contract.foundation: Quantum mechanics/statistics, thermodynamics, geometry, composition, boundary conditions and constitutive closure remain necessary. Bulk laws encode unresolved structure and interactions.

categories.runtime_choice: Use the existing near-Earth gravitational field for the demo. Select Newtonian pair/field gravity only when a later experience needs self-gravity or orbital motion.
state_and_parameters: G and source masses if self-gravity is selected
categories.law: F = m g; potential-energy change and external-field work use the same field. Pair gravity, if selected, uses a consistent potential/force and avoids self-interaction.
categories.scope: Preserve the existing qualified gravity parameter; this specification does not change runtime g or mass.
categories.falsifier: A creature that cannot fall cannot walk: disabling support must produce field-consistent acceleration and corresponding energy change.

categories.runtime_choice: Represent ordinary cohesion/contact, elastic and viscous response, friction, fluid interfaces, chemistry, heat transport, light and active biological work through selected effective material and transport models.
state_and_parameters: activation and chemical energy supply for muscle
charge/field state only for explicit electrical or magnetic experiences
categories.law: Conservative mechanical response can use F = -gradient(U); viscous/frictional processes require dissipation laws, and active work requires a declared energy supply. Surface energy is one term, not the complete bulk law.
categories.quantum_boundary: Electronic bonding, exclusion and statistics are represented in measured or qualified effective laws; the near demo does not compute every electron or sum bare Coulomb forces between all atoms.
categories.data_route: req.material_catalog and its phase, mechanical, interfacial, optical, transport and biological source routes
categories.falsifier: A material that cannot distinguish compression, shear and separation cannot claim general deformation; a muscle that cannot spend energy cannot perform powered work.

categories.runtime_choice: Use sourced element/isotope and nuclear mass/stability properties as inputs. No strong-interaction solver is required for the current creature demo.
state_and_parameters: isotope fractions and nuclear-state identity only if the selected experience needs them
evaluated atomic/nuclear masses under a declared convention
categories.law: Nuclear binding influences measured masses; do not add binding energy a second time to a rest mass that already includes it. Later nuclear reactions need evaluated channels, energy release and transport models.
categories.data_route: source.material_reference.iaea_nuclides; req.element_identity_spine is an element index, not an isotope dataset
categories.enable_when: An explicitly selected experience needs isotope-specific mass, nuclear reactions, fission/fusion or radiation production.
categories.falsifier: A nuclear model that cannot account for its reactants, products and energy cannot claim transmutation.

categories.runtime_choice: Keep weak-interaction nuclear/particle processes outside the current mechanical demo. Add evaluated decay channels only when the chosen experience requires them.
categories.law: For a selected simple decay, dN/dt = -lambda N with lambda = ln(2)/half_life; coupled daughter production and energy deposition need the full channel model. Small inventories require a declared stochastic treatment.
categories.classification: Beta decay involves weak interactions; not all radioactive decay is weak. Alpha and gamma processes must retain their actual channel physics.
categories.enable_when: A specific decay/radiation experience requires time evolution; source properties alone do not activate a runtime decay process.
categories.falsifier: A decay model that cannot retain its half-life under timestep changes cannot teach elapsed physical time.

outputs: heat, species or charge transfer where selected
common_exchange_contract.accounting: Use one paired exchange owner with consistent units, momentum and energy balances. External fields/reservoirs and radiated/escaped energy are explicit accounts.
common_exchange_contract.no_double_counting: Material energies already represent underlying interactions. Do not apply the same molecular attraction again as an additional fundamental-force contribution.
common_exchange_contract.spatial_scope: Face-neighbor exchange is suitable for local transport/contact. Gravity, electrostatic fields and eliminated interior modes may need field solves or nonlocal couplings; a local cell graph does not remove these dependencies.

database_to_runtime: Select a player-observable process and accuracy envelope.
Choose the effective model and independent state at the declared LOD.
Join sources by identity, composition/structure, quantity, units, conditions and version.
Admit parameters with uncertainty and applicability; preserve raw source provenance.
Bind the qualified law to cells/interfaces and its timestep/coupling method.
Check conserved exchanges, response fidelity and the material/process-specific falsifier.
contract.scope_now: Architecture specification only. This addition does not implement new force solvers, nuclear simulation or material response; it does not promote existing physical evidence.
contract.lod_link: req.matter_variables_lod controls spatial, model, temporal and numerical resolution. Refinement cannot recover an exact discarded microscopic state.

falsifier.statement: A force label substitutes for a constitutive law, an unresolved source is treated as a runtime constant, or the same interaction energy is counted twice.

physical.statement: Pinned scientific data is transformed through typed, condition-aware adapters into bounded effective models and observable game behavior.
physical.prediction: Changing a source-selected physical input changes the predicted response; missing inputs or invalid regimes cause an explicit refusal rather than fabricated realism.

milestones: Acquire source bytes, receipts and attribution; parse constants, body/system GM, gas thermodynamics, solid property curves and nuclide data through existing intake machinery.

premeasurement_contract.falsifier: One changed source byte, duplicate identity or changed parser is silently accepted as the original import.
Body GM becomes a planet-system mass, atomic mass becomes nuclear mass, or a blank/qualified decay value becomes an exact scalar.
An evaluator extrapolates beyond selected source bounds, assumes a heat capacity is constant over a phase change, or interprets fit error as statistical uncertainty.
For fixed composition, dU/dT differs from Cv or dH/dT differs from Cp beyond a preregistered finite-difference check; a transfer creates unaccounted energy.
Circular orbit or force-gradient checks disagree with the imported GM and the chosen point-mass potential.
One half-life fails to halve the selected parent within 1e-12 relative arithmetic error; stable/unknown/bounded half-lives silently decay; all decay Q is treated as deposited heat.
Rejected input partially mutates state, equal-state cells exchange finite net quantity, or an inventory becomes negative without a named boundary event.
The renderer substitutes animation for native dynamics, paused native state keeps evolving visually, or the player wins with the required physical interaction disabled.

contract.staging: Derive scenario-specific numerical tolerances before its measurements. Source/licensing uncertainty remains explicit. Native runtime acceptance follows source/model checks.

contract.execution_readiness: This repository assignment is explicitly authorized. No controller dispatch/checklist verification or production qualification is implied.

doc.force_source_catalog.name: Force-source catalog acquisition, replay and qualification recipe

document.boundary: Source assertions are admitted as extracted. Source-level qualifiers, per-row evaluation dates and unknowns remain. No runtime physics, reaction network, dose or commercial packaging qualification is claimed.
document.replay: Offline build uses pinned repository bytes. Reacquisition accepts exact pins only; mutable sources that changed require a new reviewed source revision.
document.source_dependencies: PyYAML 6.0.2 for NASA7 source parsing only. The parser preserves NO as a species and rejects duplicate keys and aliases.
first_findings: Default YAML 1.1 confuses NO and Boolean false.
Forty-five IAEA entries carry unresolved level assignments; their metadata remains explicit.
IAEA atomic mass is micro-AMU; blank, stable, bounded and approximate half-lives are distinct.
NIST truncated exact constants are retained as prefixes; twelve untruncated constants are selected as scalars.
Planetary-system GM includes satellites; body/system identities cannot be substituted.
NIST source-specific commercial distribution status is not asserted by this research import.

model.force_library.v1.name: Bounded effective-force and thermodynamic model library

project_spec.authorization: operator-authorized autonomous scientific implementation
project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no runtime qualification claimed

physical.statement: Compile selected graph assertions into a small native model packet with explicit regime and energy conventions.
physical.prediction: Independent reference checks reproduce the imported models and reject unsupported states.

derived_constants.R: Exact decimal product k_B*N_A, then represented in FP64; do not promote the truncated printed R prefix.
derived_constants.molar_mass: Sum element relative atomic masses times NIST atomic mass constant times Avogadro constant; preserve source uncertainty as unknown where not supplied.

contract.state_contract: Gas inventory in mol plus internal energy in J and volume in m3 are independent; pressure and temperature are derived. Source enthalpy reference conventions remain intact.
contract.pressure_work: For adiabatic ideal-gas mechanical coupling use entropy as the invariant or account for pressure-volume work explicitly. A derivative of U(T) at fixed T is not the pressure force.
contract.energy_boundary: Nuclear binding and decay tables are metadata/evaluated effective laws. Parent disappearance is not automatically deposited heat, daughter-network completeness or radiation dose.

premeasurement_checks.check: Native Cp,H,S,U against pinned Cantera 3.1.0 for 53 species inside their individual ranges, including both sides of range joins.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Cp and S: abs<=1e-7 J/(mol K)+2e-11 relative; H and U: abs<=1e-5 J/mol+2e-11 relative. This is implementation agreement, not experimental fit accuracy.

premeasurement_checks.check: dH/dT=Cp and dU/dT=Cv by central differences away from source knots.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Relative error <=1e-6, using a 0.001 K perturbation and positive reference heat capacity.

premeasurement_checks.check: Energy-to-temperature inversion and mixing at fixed volume.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Temperature closure <=1e-6 K within a continuous source segment; total energy balance <=1e-10 relative plus 1e-10 J. Out-of-range energy and unresolvable source-knot gaps refuse.

premeasurement_checks.check: Gravity is negative gradient of the selected point-mass potential.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Relative finite-difference force error <=1e-7 at a 7e6 m Earth-center distance using 10 m differences. Body/system identity remains explicit.

premeasurement_checks.check: Solid curves against independent high-precision evaluation.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Relative arithmetic error <=1e-8 inside stated ranges; all out-of-range probes refuse. Source-fit errors remain separately reported.

premeasurement_checks.check: Half-life decay and stable/unknown/qualified metadata controls.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Half-life and semigroup parent-fraction errors <=1e-12. Unresolved levels and unknown/bounded/approximate half-lives refuse scalar decay. Stable records remain unchanged.

premeasurement_checks.check: Compiler binds content-addressed records to replayed pinned raw-source semantics.
premeasurement_checks.acceptance: Changed coefficients, changed source bytes, changed units, duplicate selections and arbitrary model family labels refuse; compiled packet contains selected inputs only.

contract.status: Specification and preregistration. Native library and dynamic scene acceptance are pending.
contract.next_experience: A sealed-gas actuator can convert supplied heat into pressure-volume work against a load. Source temperature ranges and mechanical stability must define its operating envelope before live measurements.

falsifier.statement: Source counts or visually plausible output substitute for verified units, thermodynamic closure, force gradients and data provenance.

doc.force_model_library.name: Native effective models: reductions, operation and validation

project_spec.authorization: operator-authorized scientific implementation
project_spec.authority_scope: repository operation and measured candidate report; no game qualification

physical.statement: Selected pinned data is compiled into a bounded native SI model library.
physical.prediction: Independent references agree and unsupported input refuses before state mutation.

contract.independent_reference: Install cantera==3.1.0 into a separate environment or the --reference-path directory. Required evaluator: missing or wrong version fails qualification, never a silent skip.
contract.result_scope: 2686 native numerical checks and 74 intake/compiler regression tests pass on this candidate. Implementation agreement only; source fit uncertainty and dynamic gameplay qualification are separate.

model_mapping.gravity: JPL GM -> a=-mu*r/|r|^3, U=-m*mu/|r|. NAIF body vs planetary-system identity preserved; no gravity softening, body surface or ephemeris invented.
model_mapping.electromagnetic_effective: Macroscopic gas thermodynamics and solid constitutive curves encode matter response without running microscopic electromagnetic interactions. No claim that surface tension alone determines shear or bulk response.
model_mapping.strong_effective: Evaluated nuclide binding energies are metadata in J/nucleon and J/nucleus. Not a nuclear interaction solver or available heat.
model_mapping.weak_effective: Evaluated half-life -> expected parent fraction exp(-ln(2)*dt/t_half); stable unchanged, unknown/qualified/unresolved inputs refuse. Neither daughter completeness nor deposited decay heat is inferred.

contract.gas_state: Independent n_i in mol, U in J, V in m3. p=nRT/V; U=sum n_i*(h_i-RT); Cv=Cp-R. Formation-energy offsets stay intact, so U can be negative. Mixture entropy includes partial-pressure mixing terms. Energy/entropy inversion checks each source-polynomial interval and refuses unresolvable gaps or multiple answers.
contract.element_mass_reduction: Only selected AtomicMass cells are explicitly reduced: M_species=sum stoichiometry*A_r*m_u*N_A. Raw cells are replayed against the pinned PubChem table. These are conventional tabulated element masses, not arbitrary isotope abundances. Missing uncertainty remains unknown.
contract.provenance: Compiler checks record content digests and independently replays selected raw-source semantics. Historical intake producer IDs are preserved. Adding a new compiler does not retroactively make it the producer of old evidence.
contract.runtime_boundary: Compiled packet is a small SI data artifact, not executable imported code. Native loading validates law families, shape, finite values, regimes and derived-R consistency. Source/cryptographic provenance verification belongs to compilation/launch; a bare native packet load is not an independent attestation of raw-source authenticity.
contract.remaining: Native library is ready for a separately qualified sealed-gas/load mechanical experiment. No creature force-state, solid fracture, nuclear heat, full atmosphere, propulsion, combat, or pay gate is asserted.

falsifier.statement: A source count, imported equation or successful parse substitutes for numerical or gameplay qualification.

experience.science.thermal_salvage.name: Thermal salvage: turn a finite energy charge into useful motion

project_spec.authorization: operator-authorized native science demo and space RPG direction
project_spec.authority_scope: authored scenario and preregistration; no game qualification

physical.statement: A finite heater charge raises a loaded mechanism through measured gas pressure and mechanical reaction.
physical.prediction: Heating produces motion with an energy balance; without heat the balanced mechanism stays at rest.

gravity.reduction: Uniform local field from mu/r^2. No planetary surface-radius claim.

contract.authored_not_measured: Geometry, load, damping ratio, game thresholds and available heater energy are explicit scenario design inputs. Source tables supply gas thermo, gravity GM and the beam modulus. Ideal slender elastic beam assumes small deflection; yield/plasticity is not qualified.
contract.boundary: Closed gas inventory. Vacuum external pressure. Walls thermally insulating; heater supplies explicit heat. Mechanical damper loses energy to an external reservoir tracked in the ledger. Beam thermal state fixed at 290 K and mechanically ideal; no inferred wall heat transfer.

controls.command: heater_fraction in [0,1]; reset restores initial scenario exactly

time.physics_inputs: Intent only; browser cannot submit a solved pose or overwrite measured energy.

contract.solver: Strang split: half heater energy at fixed volume; discrete-gradient mechanical step with gas entropy invariant; half heater energy. Scalar implicit solve couples gas pressure, gravity, beam elasticity and damping.
contract.derivation: At fixed gas entropy, dU=-p*dV. Average gas force is -(U1-U0)/(x1-x0), with its pressure limit at equal positions. With midpoint velocity, m*(v1-v0)/h=Fgas-mg-k*(x0+x1)/2-c*vbar. Multiplication by (x1-x0)=h*vbar makes delta(K+U+mg*x+0.5*k*x^2)=-c*h*vbar^2. Heater input and damper output are separately accumulated, not used to overwrite state and manufacture balance.

preregistered_checks.test: Closed-step total energy ledger for driven and unheated runs at 300 Hz.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: Absolute balance residual <=1e-8 J +1e-8*max(1 J, cumulative supplied heat). Finite state and constant moles required; failed update preserves prior state.

preregistered_checks.test: 3 seconds: 2 W for first 1.5 seconds, then coast; compare native 300 Hz trajectory with high-accuracy independent Cantera/SciPy ODE reference.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: Position absolute error <=20 micrometers; velocity <=0.0002 m/s; temperature <=0.05 K at sampled times. Reference uses native-independent thermo evaluation and equations.

preregistered_checks.test: Isolated 300 Hz CPU step timings on this host.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: Report median/p95/p99 and solver iterations. p95 <=3.333 ms; qualification is host-specific, not a universal performance promise.

preregistered_checks.test: Zero heat at equilibrium for 3000 ticks, plus invalid intents and source-envelope violations.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: No-heat displacement <=1e-9 m. Invalid updates refuse and do not partially change physical inventory, energy, pose or battery.

preregistered_checks.test: Player loop reset, energy exhaustion, goal dwell and failure.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: Reset identical initial physical values; heater never creates energy beyond battery; exhaustion named. Goal requires measured position and speed continuously for the stated dwell; no animation or request directly marks success.

preregistered_checks.test: Render/CPU separation and visible native geometry.
preregistered_checks.acceptance: Same intent sequence at same tick produces identical physical state independent of render batching; visible frame and state share scene/revision identity. Changing heat input changes native motion; zero heat does not.

contract.qualification: Preregistered bounded build. Dynamic implementation and visible-game acceptance pending.

falsifier.statement: A mechanism that cannot account for its work cannot teach energy conversion.

doc.thermal_salvage.name: Thermal salvage: operate and reproduce the native game loop

project_spec.authorization: Operator-authorized scientific implementation and documentation
project_spec.authority_scope: Repository operation and measured candidate report; no controller or full-product promotion

physical.statement: Source-derived thermodynamics, elasticity and gravity drive a finite-energy salvage task in the native engine.
physical.prediction: The commands reproduce scoped observations on a pinned candidate; missing inputs and failed checks remain explicit.

contract.launcher_contract: Separate .tmp/thermal-engine build; refuses occupied port. Supply -Python/-CMake executable paths when needed. Compiles graph offline and records PID, executable SHA and scene identity in .tmp/thermal-salvage/runtime.json. -SkipBuild does not qualify a stale executable.
contract.play: Hold HEAT to raise the mechanism; release inside 10-14 mm and settle below 3 mm/s for one second. Charge 4 J, heater maximum 2 W. Spending the charge before recovery produces CHARGE SPENT. Reset restores the initial experiment. One active operator per local scene; not a multiplayer control protocol.
contract.state_ownership: Native state owns moles, energy, position, velocity, battery, dissipation and goal dwell. Browser sends heater intent, pause or reset only. Unrenewed heater intent expires after 500 ms. Physics runs at 300 Hz independently of rendering. Failed updates preserve the previous complete state and stop drive; no silent energy correction or dropped physics ticks.
contract.geometry: The native 48-sided, 17-ring chamber is closed. Polygonal-frustum normalization makes signed triangle volume agree with V0+A*x. Uniform render scale is 25 units/m. The beam follows the ideal small-deflection profile defining its stiffness. Diagnostic colors are not measured optics.
contract.capture_identity: /thermal_frame returns JPEG and its exact rendered state with capture_sequence and scene_revision. Live control state and frame state remain distinct. scene_revision increases across resets while tick/sim_time restart. Browser rejects older revisions, handles external resets and never relabels an old image as fresh.
contract.solver_detail: Half heat, entropy-conserving mechanical work, half heat. Work uses the integral of p*A along the entropy-preserving path, with checked 2/4-point Gauss quadrature: the cancellation-safe form of -(U1-U0)/(x1-x0). A bracketed scalar solve couples gas, gravity, beam and damping. The independent energy ledger never overwrites state.
contract.failure_found: Direct energy subtraction lost precision near rest and honestly refused at tick 592. Pressure integration removed the cancellation without changing preregistered energy/trajectory tolerances.

initial_measurements.scope: Precommit exploratory measurements. Postcommit receipt identifies the released candidate and controls.

contract.independent_reference: Install cantera==3.1.0, numpy==2.2.6, scipy==1.14.1 and Cantera dependency ruamel.yaml in the isolated --reference-path directory. Missing reference is a failure. DOP853 independently integrates dx=v; m*dv=p*A-m*g-k*x-c*v; n*Cv*dT=power-p*A*v; dLoss=c*v*v with rtol=1e-11 and atol=1e-12.
limits: One ideal bellows/load, not the creature XPBD appliance. No creature force-state claim is promoted.
Beam is massless, linear elastic and small-deflection. Yield, fracture and wall stiffness remain unqualified.
Ideal N2 within selected NASA7 bounds: no phase change, leaks, chemistry, radiation or wall heat transfer.
Uniform local gravity from Earth GM. This supported fixture is not a free-falling spacecraft; a space game must declare its supporting or accelerating reference frame.
Playable causal mechanism does not establish commercial appeal, the $25 gate, a finished RPG or engine release qualification.
Source-specific distribution uncertainty in doc.force_source_catalog remains.
contract.fixed_observation_frame: The render loop reapplies the graph-declared camera and publishes its actual eight values with each captured state. Native view input cannot accumulate view drift between fixture trials.

falsifier.statement: Unmeasured scope is represented as proven, or a changed candidate silently reuses this measurement.

doc.native_readback_diagnosis.name: Readback diagnosis: caching and measured CPU access

project_spec.authorization: Operator-authorized scientific implementation and documentation
project_spec.authority_scope: Repository operation and measured candidate report; no controller or full-product promotion

physical.statement: Coherent but uncached readback memory made scalar CPU image conversion take about 917 ms on this host.
physical.prediction: The commands reproduce scoped observations on a pinned candidate; missing inputs and failed checks remain explicit.

contract.cause: Old allocator preferred non-device-local HOST_COHERENT before HOST_CACHED, selecting type 2 flags 6 (visible/coherent/uncached). Coherency governs visibility and invalidation; it does not promise cached CPU loads.
contract.experiment: Exploratory A/B on RTX 4090 with the same scene in a presenting native process. Map, invalidate, bulk-copy, conversion/read and unmap are instrumented per capture. Paused geometry and equal JPEG settings hold pixels constant. Diagnostic experiment, not retrospectively preregistered.

observed_controls.uncached_bulk_first: 34-35 ms memcpy plus 0.96 ms conversion; about 55 ms pull
observed_controls.cached_direct: type 3 flags 14; 1.76-1.81 ms conversion; 22-28 ms pull

contract.correction: Prefer host-cached readback memory, including correctly invalidated noncoherent memory. If unavailable, sequential bulk-copy into cached RAM before swizzling. Map complete allocation before whole-allocation invalidate. Preserve capture fencing and pixel semantics.

diagnostic_controls.CHIMERA_RB_DIRECT_CONTROL: 1 bypasses automatic uncached bulk fallback; combine with uncached control to reproduce original

contract.default: No diagnostic switches. Never infer caching from HOST_COHERENT alone.
contract.scope: Identifies this engine path on this host, not every historic 900 ms report or driver. This evidence does not require a 27-frame present queue. Measure phase and memory flags before attributing delay to scheduling.
contract.process_scope: Requires a free port; creates and stops only its own three sequential native processes. Same executable, graph scene, fixed camera and JPEG output. Records exact memory flags and per-capture phase times.

source.operator.space_mechanism_scope_20.name: Space mechanism catalog: operator scope summary

document.text:
Authored technical summary of the operator's request, not a verbatim transcript.
Inventory reusable mechanisms needed for a space RPG as special LEGO-like pieces. For each family identify scientific databases, equation/model libraries or solver implementations that shorten development. Keep material recipes and assembled devices separate from their reusable laws. Store the catalog, missing data, falsifiers and staged build order in the project graph; README is the entrypoint.
