ref.uberon.UBERON_1200015.name: articular surface for cuboid bone of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200015.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the anterior articular facet on the distal end of the calcaneus that articulates with the proximal surface of the cuboid bone, constituting the calcaneocuboid joint and contributing to the transverse tarsal (Chopart) joint complex.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200015.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200017.name: auricular surface of ilium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200017.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the ear-shaped articular surface on the posteromedial aspect of the ilium of the os coxa (innominate bone), covered by fibrocartilage and articulating with the corresponding auricular surface of the sacrum to form the sacroiliac joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200017.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200018.name: base of first distal phalanx of foot
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200018.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the hallux, bearing a concave articular surface that articulates with the head of the proximal phalanx of the first toe at the interphalangeal joint of the hallux.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200018.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200019.name: base of first distal phalanx of hand
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200019.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal articular end of the distal phalanx of the thumb, presenting a concave surface that articulates with the head of the proximal phalanx at the interphalangeal joint of the thumb.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200019.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200020.name: base of first proximal phalanx of foot
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200020.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the hallux, bearing a concave articular facet that articulates with the first metatarsal head at the first metatarsophalangeal joint and receives the insertions of the flexor hallucis brevis tendons via the sesamoid complex.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200020.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200021.name: base of first proximal phalanx of hand
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200021.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the thumb, presenting an oval concave articular surface that receives the head of the first metacarpal at the metacarpophalangeal joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200021.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200022.name: body of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200022.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the large central mass of the calcaneus, situated between the calcaneal tuberosity posteriorly and the articular surfaces anteriorly, and bearing the posterior and middle talar articular facets on its superior surface.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200022.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200025.name: calcaneal sulcus of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200025.definition: A surface groove oriented obliquely on the superior surface of the calcaneus, running between the posterior and middle talar articular facets. Together with the corresponding sulcus tali of the talus it forms the tarsal sinus, which lodges the interosseous talocalcaneal ligament.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200025.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200027.name: coronoid fossa of humerus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200027.definition: A bone fossa situated on the anterior surface of the distal humerus, immediately superior to the medial trochlea, that accommodates the coronoid process of the ulna at full elbow flexion. It is separated from the olecranon fossa on the posterior surface only by a thin plate of bone.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200027.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200042.name: fibular facet of tibia
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200042.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the slightly concave articular surface on the inferoposterior aspect of the lateral condyle of the tibia, which articulates with the head of the fibula at the proximal tibiofibular joint. It is oriented posterolaterally and is reinforced by the anterior and posterior ligaments of the proximal tibiofibular joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200042.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200043.name: fibular notch of tibia
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200043.definition: A bone foramen forming the concave depression on the lateral aspect of the distal tibial epiphysis that receives the distal end of the fibula, constituting the tibial component of the inferior tibiofibular syndesmosis. Its surfaces are roughened for attachment of the anterior and posterior tibiofibular ligaments and the interosseous ligament.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200043.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200044.name: fibular trochlea of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200044.definition: A skeletal element projection forming the small, ridge-like eminence on the lateral surface of the calcaneus, situated between the superior and inferior peroneal retinacula; it separates the tendon grooves of the fibularis brevis above from the fibularis longus below.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200044.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200050.name: gluteal surface of ilium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200050.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the broad, posterolateral convex surface of the ilium of the os coxa (innominate bone), bounded by the iliac crest superiorly and the acetabulum inferiorly, and providing the origin for the three gluteal muscles and the tensor fasciae latae.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200050.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200051.name: gluteal tuberosity of femur
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200051.definition: A skeletal element projection situated on the posterior surface of the femoral shaft, lateral to the linea aspera, extending from the base of the greater trochanter inferiorly. It presents as a roughened ridge or elongated eminence and serves as the primary insertion site for the gluteus maximus muscle.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200051.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200055.name: groove for fibularis longus tendon of cuboid
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200055.definition: A surface groove forming the oblique channel on the plantar surface of the cuboid bone, through which the tendon of fibularis longus passes as it crosses the sole of the foot to insert on the medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200055.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200064.name: groove for tendon of flexor hallucis longus muscle of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200064.definition: A surface groove running longitudinally along the inferior aspect of the sustentaculum tali of the calcaneus, through which the tendon of the flexor hallucis longus muscle passes distally toward the hallux. The tendon is held within the groove by a fibrous retinaculum.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200064.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200067.name: head of radius of radius
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200067.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the disc-shaped proximal end of the radius, articulating superiorly with the capitulum of the humerus and medially with the radial notch of the ulna; it is encircled by the annular ligament and enables forearm pronation and supination.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200067.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200068.name: head of second distal phalanx of foot
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200068.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the distal articular end of the second distal phalanx of the foot, presenting a smooth convex surface at the tip of the second toe; it bears no distal articulation and is capped by the ungual tuberosity.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200069.name: head of second distal phalanx of hand
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200069.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the distal end of the distal phalanx of the second toe of the foot, presenting a smooth convex articular surface that articulates with the base of the middle phalanx at the proximal interphalangeal joint of the second digit.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200069.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200070.name: head of second middle phalanx of foot
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200070.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the distal articular end of the middle phalanx of the second toe, presenting a pulley-shaped trochlear surface that articulates with the base of the second distal phalanx of the foot at the distal interphalangeal joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200070.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200071.name: head of second middle phalanx of hand
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200071.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the distal end of the middle phalanx of the second toe of the foot, bearing a pulley-shaped (trochlear) articular surface that articulates with the base of the distal phalanx at the distal interphalangeal joint of the second digit.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200071.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200072.name: head of third middle phalanx of hand
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200072.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the distal articular end of the middle phalanx of the third finger, presenting a trochlear articular surface that articulates with the base of the third distal phalanx at the distal interphalangeal joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200072.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200073.name: head of ulna of ulna
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200073.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the rounded distal end of the ulna, articulating with the ulnar notch of the radius via its convex articular circumference and with the triangular fibrocartilage complex on its inferior surface, participating in the distal radioulnar joint.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200073.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200080.name: iliac tubercle of ilium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200080.definition: A skeletal element projection forming a thickened prominence on the outer lip of the iliac crest of the ilium of the os coxa (innominate bone), situated approximately five centimetres posterior to the anterior superior iliac spine and serving as a palpable landmark used in clinical procedures such as lumbar puncture positioning.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200080.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200081.name: iliac tuberosity of ilium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200081.definition: A skeletal element projection forming a roughened elevation on the posterior part of the medial surface of the ilium of the os coxa (innominate bone), located superior and posterior to the auricular surface, providing attachment for the posterior sacroiliac ligaments and the erector spinae.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200081.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200082.name: iliopubic ramus of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200082.definition: A skeletal element projection forming the bony bar of the os coxa (innominate bone) that connects the body of the ilium to the pubis, constituting the superior and medial boundary of the obturator foramen and carrying the obturator groove on its inferior surface.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200082.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200110.name: infraglenoid tubercle of scapula
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200110.definition: A roughened skeletal element projection situated at the inferior margin of the glenoid cavity of the scapula, serving as the origin of the long head of the triceps brachii muscle.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200110.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200112.name: infraspinous fossa of scapula
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200112.definition: A broad, triangular bone fossa occupying the inferior three-quarters of the posterior surface of the scapula below the scapular spine, providing the area of origin for the infraspinatus muscle.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200112.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200113.name: intercondylar notch of femur
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200113.definition: A bone foramen forming the deep intercondylar fossa between the medial and lateral condyles on the posterior aspect of the distal femur. It provides passage for the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments and is partially enclosed anteriorly by the patellar surface.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200113.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200117.name: interosseus border of tibia
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200117.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the sharp, prominent lateral crest of the tibial shaft, running from the fibular articular facet proximally to the anterior aspect of the fibular notch distally. It provides the tibial attachment for the crural interosseous membrane connecting the tibia and fibula throughout the length of the leg.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200117.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200118.name: ischial body of ischium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200118.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the thick, upper part of the ischium of the os coxa (innominate bone), contributing the posteroinferior portion of the acetabulum superiorly and bearing the ischial spine posteriorly, and providing attachment for several hip muscles and ligaments.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200118.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200123.name: lateral process of tuberosity of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200123.definition: A skeletal element projection forming the smaller, more lateral of the two inferior prominences of the calcaneal tuberosity. It provides attachment for the abductor digiti minimi muscle and the lateral slip of the plantar aponeurosis.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200123.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200128.name: lunate surface of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200128.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the crescent-shaped articular cartilage-covered surface within the acetabulum of the os coxa (innominate bone), lining the peripheral rim of the acetabular socket and articulating directly with the head of the femur, with the non-articular acetabular fossa occupying the central gap.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200128.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200140.name: medial malleolus of tibia
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200140.definition: A skeletal element projection forming the prominent bony process that descends from the medial aspect of the distal tibia, constituting the medial wall of the ankle mortise. Its lateral surface bears a comma-shaped articular facet for the medial surface of the talar body, and its apex and posterior groove give attachment to the deltoid ligament complex and tendons of the deep posterior compartment, respectively.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200140.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200141.name: medial process of tuberosity of calcaneus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200141.definition: A skeletal element projection forming the larger, more medial of the two inferior prominences of the calcaneal tuberosity. It is the principal origin of the plantar aponeurosis and provides attachment for the abductor hallucis, flexor digitorum brevis, and the plantar calcaneonavicular (spring) ligament.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200141.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200148.name: neck of radius of radius
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200148.definition: A zone of bone organ comprising the short, constricted segment of the radius immediately distal to the head, connecting the head to the radial tuberosity and serving as the site of attachment of the annular ligament.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200148.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200160.name: obturator groove of pubis of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200160.definition: A surface groove forming the oblique channel running along the inferior surface of the superior pubic ramus of the pubis of the os coxa (innominate bone), roofed by the obturator membrane to form the obturator canal through which the obturator nerve and vessels pass from the pelvis to the thigh.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200160.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200166.name: pecten pubis of pubis of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200166.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the sharp, ridge-like superior border of the superior pubic ramus of the pubis of the os coxa (innominate bone), extending from the pubic tubercle to the iliopectineal eminence and forming part of the pelvic brim, with the pectineus muscle attaching to its anterior surface.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200166.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200167.name: pectinal line of femur
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200167.definition: A zone of bone organ forming a raised ridge on the posterior surface of the proximal femoral shaft, running obliquely from the base of the lesser trochanter to the medial lip of the linea aspera. It serves as the insertion site for the pectineus muscle.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200167.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200174.name: posterior gluteal line of ilium of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200174.definition: A zone of bone organ forming a curved ridge near the posterior margin of the gluteal surface of the ilium of the os coxa (innominate bone), extending from the iliac crest toward the greater sciatic notch and demarcating the small posterior area of origin of the gluteus maximus from the larger area of the gluteus medius.
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200174.notes: EXTRACTED: Uberon states it; not a creature part, not physically verified. Human anatomy is REFERENCE, never automatically Chimera proportions.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200182.name: pubic body of pubis of os coxa
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200182.definition: A zone of bone organ forming the flattened, medial main portion of the pubis of the os coxa (innominate bone), presenting a medial symphyseal surface that articulates with the contralateral pubic body at the pubic symphysis and a superior surface bearing the pubic crest and pubic tubercle.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200186.name: radial fossa of humerus

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200187.name: radial groove of humerus
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200187.definition: A surface groove spiraling obliquely across the posterior surface of the humeral shaft from the medial to the lateral side, separating the origins of the medial and lateral heads of the triceps brachii. ref.uberon.UBERON_1200188.name: radial tuberosity of radius

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200197.name: scaphoid tubercle of scaphoid
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200197.definition: A skeletal element projection on the palmar surface of the scaphoid bone at its distal pole, forming the lateral pillar of the carpal tunnel and serving as an attachment point for the flexor retinaculum and the abductor pollicis brevis muscle.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200198.name: scapular notch of scapula
ref.uberon.UBERON_1200198.definition: A semicircular bone foramen on the superior border of the scapula, medial to the base of the coracoid process, through which the suprascapular nerve passes beneath the superior transverse scapular ligament to enter the supraspinous fossa.

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200199.name: scapular spine of scapula

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200201.name: shaft of first distal phalanx of hand

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200202.name: shaft of first proximal phalanx of hand

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200203.name: shaft of radius of radius

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200204.name: shaft of ulna of ulna

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200205.name: soleal line of tibia

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200257.name: supinator fossa of ulna

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200261.name: supraspinous fossa of scapula

ref.uberon.UBERON_1200262.name: sustentaculum tali of calcaneus

ref.uberon.UBERON_3000941.definition: Pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are elaborated into posteriorly directed epicoracoid horns. Most arciferal pectoral girdles are characterized by fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region. Posterior to the clavicles, the epicoracoids usually are free and overlapping.

ref.uberon.UBERON_3000942.name: firmisternal girdle

The sternum is fused to the pectoral arch, and the epicoracoid cartilages of each half of the girdle are fused to one another. The midzonal length of the girdle is shorter than that of an arciferal girdle, but pre- and postzonal elements tend to be longer.
